nodes.description: Immutable IFree external contract reference set in the constructor from the freeAddr argument.
Mapping(address => Stake) holding each staker's first/second stake block numbers, mint block number and total staked ETH.
Mapping(uint256 => bool) tracking whether a Free0 NFT has already been consumed for a Free3 mint.
Privileged address that can withdraw failed stakes and transfer administratorship.
Immutable minimum number of blocks that must elapse between the first and second stake / before claiming.
Immutable block window upper bound used both to gate staking/claiming and to detect failed (expired) stakes.
Constructor: stores IFree address, stakePeriod, progressPeriodExpiration and sets administrator = msg.sender.
Admin-only function that overwrites the administrator state variable with a new address.
Payable first stake: records firstStakeBlockNumber and accumulates totalStaked; requires >= 0.25 ether and no previous first stake.
Payable second stake gated by a block-number window between firstStakeBlockNumber+stakePeriod and firstStakeBlockNumber+progressPeriodExpiration.
Admin-only recovery of staked ETH when both stake windows expired, ETH is still staked and no token was minted; pays administrator.
Mints a Free3 (collectionId 3) after verifying Free0 ownership and block window; appends attribute, marks token used, refunds/returns staked ETH.
Caller-controlled address used as mapping key, admin check subject, owner check and payout recipient.
Miner-influenceable block time reference (block.number used in this contract) driving all staking/claim/withdraw windows.
payable(administrator).transfer(stake.totalStaked) executed before stake.totalStaked is reset to zero.
payable(msg.sender).transfer(stake.totalStaked) in claim, executed after an external call and before stake.totalStaked = 0.
External call free.mint(3, msg.sender) into the caller-supplied IFree contract inside claim.
External call free.appendAttributeToToken(free0TokenId, ...) into the caller-supplied IFree contract inside claim.
New administrator address supplied to transferAdministratorship.
Staker address supplied to withdraw, used to index addressToStakes.
Free0 token id supplied to claim, validated through IFree and free0TokenIdUsed.
